not_set_up.said: Not set up: JARVIS_IMAP_USER is not set - sending uses the same account as reading email, and there is none. The steps are in backend/README.md, "Sending email".

ready.said: Ready: from owner@example.com through smtp.gmail.com, port 465, encrypted. Every email is its own approval card showing all of it; there is no "always allow".

refused_auto.said: Set up (from owner@example.com through smtp.gmail.com, port 465, encrypted), but send_email is tier 'auto' in jarvis-framework.toml, which would send without asking anyone; every email needs the owner's yes on a card, so nothing is sent until it is "ask".

starttls.said: Ready: from owner@example.com through smtp.office365.com, port 587, encrypted. Every email is its own approval card showing all of it; there is no "always allow".

switched_off.said: Set up (from owner@example.com through smtp.gmail.com, port 465, encrypted), but sending email is switched off on this PC (send_email is "never" in jarvis-framework.toml's [autonomy.tiers]).

tool_off.said: Set up (from owner@example.com through smtp.gmail.com, port 465, encrypted). Jarvis does not offer to send until "send_email" is added to [tools].enabled in jarvis-framework.toml on the PC.

example_body:
Hi Alex,

Friday at 7 works for me. [the menu](https://example.com/menu)

**See you there.**

Mario
example_card:
Send this email from your account? It goes only if you approve, exactly as shown - every word is below.

From: owner@example.com
To: alex@example.com
Cc: sam@example.org
Subject: Dinner on Friday

---------- the whole email ----------
Hi Alex,

Friday at 7 works for me. [the menu](https://example.com/menu)

**See you there.**

Mario
---------- end of the email ----------

No attachments, no hidden (Bcc) recipients.
It goes through smtp.office365.com, port 587, encrypted before logging in (STARTTLS - if the server will not encrypt, nothing is sent). Jarvis logs in there as owner@example.com; your password goes to that server and nowhere else.
Once sent, an email cannot be taken back.

If you say no: nothing is sent, and Jarvis tells you it was not sent.
